shortname.description: A unique FareHarbor name assigned to each company when their Dashboard is created, used to access the company's specific information.

direct_thread_id.description: The direct thread ID for the guest.

time.description: The arrival time (set in the company's local time); the customer must provide their own transporation and arrive at the activity location by this time.

capacity.description: The overall maximum number of customers that can currently book this availability; this number will change over time as other customers book.

end_at.description: The availability's end time (set in the company's local time); note that this time can be arbitrarily long or short, and that start_at can equal end_at for 'point' availabilities.

start_at.description: The availability's start time (set in the company's local time); note that this time can be arbitrarily long or short, and that start_at can equal end_at for 'point' availabilities.

availability.description: The availability to which this booking corresponds.

created_at.description: The date and time at which the booking was created (set in utc time).

customer_count.description: The number of customers on this booking.

customers.description: A list of customers on this booking.

oneOf.description: The invoice price of this booking. Assuming that the user of the API is a reseller this will be the amount that the user of the API owes the vendor on this booking, if the vendor has opted to set up that information; otherwise it will be null.

is_subscribed_for_sms_updates.description: Whether or not the contact would like the booking company to send them SMS updates about this booking. Note that the value of this field does not reflect whether or not the user has sent a STOP request to FareHarbor. If the user sends a STOP request to an External API client, that API client should respect that request.

order.description: When there is no order associated with the booking, order will be null.

bookings.description: Booking UUIDs related to the order

uuid.description: The booking's universally unique identifier; used to access the booking via the API.
